body.x: Toddy Gear, creator of the stylish Toddy Smart Cloth, introduces Screensters™, their latest collection of cleaning solutions for touchscreens and sensitive surfaces. Inspired by the characters you encounter in everyday life and catered to children and adults alike, Screensters™ bring a hint of flair and personality to your mobile devices, while maintaining their pristine condition. To see the Screensters™ collection for yourself at the Consumer Electronics Show visit Toddy Gear in the North Hall Booth #6622.

Modeled after the people you encounter every day, Screensters™ come in 10 collectible characters. From the fashion forward “Stylista” to the gaming-enthusiast “Gameawn,” each character is sure to reflect your personality and sense of style. Made to fit comfortably in your pocket or attach to your bag/backpack, Screensters™ deliver premium quality and are the perfect companion for your smart phone, MP3 player, e-reader, tablet, gaming devices, and other sensitive electronics.

The dual-sided, microfiber dolls have a plush side that absorbs dust and oils, and a silky side that polishes any screen or lens to keep your gadgets “out of the box clean.” Each Screenster™ doll is protected with an antimicrobial coating that prevents the buildup of mold and mildew.

“We strive to always be ahead of the curve, to be the trend setters when it comes to stylish accessories for our beloved gadgets,” said Toddy Gear founder, Todd Gabel. “Our new line draws directly from the individual, exuding personality, style and a unique view of the world.”
